_comment: Kernel.run() dispatch overhead baselines. ceiling_ms is the CI enforcement ceiling (generous). measured_ms is the P99 observed on a developer workstation. Tighten ceiling_ms as performance improves.
_methodology: 100 or 1000 sequential kernel.run() calls against a deterministic WASM stub. Measures TypeScript boundary overhead only (dispatch, cache key hashing, OTEL span emission, result validation).

dfg_n100.description: 100 sequential DFG runs (distinct log handles, no cache hits)

dfg_n1k.description: 1000 sequential DFG runs (distinct log handles, no cache hits)

heuristic_n100.description: 100 sequential heuristic_miner runs (distinct log handles, no cache hits)

alpha_n100.description: 100 sequential alpha_plus_plus runs (distinct log handles, no cache hits)

span_capture_overhead.description: 100 DFG runs with an in-process span capture sink — measures OTEL emission overhead
